title: 5 systems you should automate today
summary: These five systems are ripe for automation—and we've got secure, AI-powered templates and pro tips to help you automate them in minutes.
body_markdown: Spreadsheets are great for storing information, but they're not built for acting on it quickly. For a more dynamic automated system, try[Zapier Tables](https://zapier.com/tables) . With it, you can store data, trigger automations, and connect all your organization's apps and workflows to your spreadsheet data.
